description: This Java class is an event listener that handles successful authentication events in a Spring Security context. It resets the failed login attempts for a user upon successful login.

classes.name: AuthenticationSuccessListener
classes.description: A Spring component that listens for successful authentication events and resets user failed login attempts.

methods.name: AuthenticationSuccessListener
methods.description: Constructor that injects the UserService dependency.

methods.name: onApplicationEvent
methods.description: Handles the AuthenticationSuccessEvent by resetting failed login attempts for the user.
